_comment: OrigamDataTableHeaderCell component tokens — issue #503 (Paquet 1, cause C). The component's own CSS class (.origam-data-table-header-cell, verified in the .vue template/style root selector) is a standalone compound block, NOT a BEM child of data-table (contrast with data-table.json's existing 'header' key, which is nested under 'data-table' and therefore emits the mismatched --origam-data-table__header---* — never read by this component). Values copied verbatim from OrigamDataTableHeaderCell.vue's SCSS fallbacks, all of which already reference live, currently-emitted modern semantic vars (--origam-color__text---primary, --origam-color__surface---raised, --origam-color__border---default, --origam-space---1, --origam-radius---full) — so this file mirrors those exact semantic references for true zero-visual-change. NOTE: --origam-data-table-sortable---cursor (read at the same call site, line 246) is a DISTINCT top-level block name ('data-table-sortable', not 'data-table-header-cell') and is intentionally left out of this file — flagged separately, see delivery report.

opacity-hover.$description: Flat property name (not a $state) — mirrors the component's own literal 'opacity-hover' CSS var segment.

opacity-active.$description: Flat property name, same reasoning as opacity-hover.
